related: WSP109/#1069 pre-existing exact given36 posterior; AAI11B/#1061 and DG1MD30/#1027 pre-existing negatives. This experiment instead tests native persistent structure search over a generic program grammar, no truth family label and no fixed36 candidate law list.
mission: Transition isolated CKAD native evidence experiments toward a persistent stateful non-token causal learner: maintain multiple structural hypotheses, revise after witnessed interventions, select discriminating input/action pairs, cold retain prior worlds without retraining or copying native state.

in_family.truth: five binary contexts + one action, private linear XOR term mask, output bias, plus action-gated AND of one or two positive context variables. SHA256 seed chooses coefficients. No true term indices or family label to learner.

shift.truth: Private XOR of context/action linear component and action-gated AND of three distinct positive context variables; not expressible by candidate grammar except incidental observed coincidences. Family label hidden from learner.

corrupt.truth: In-family source but two of eight fixed initial observation labels deliberately flipped by a fixed seed-hash. Later real observations from unchanged truth. Corruption flags unavailable to learner.

worlds.inputs: 6 binary bits: five public context attributes and one binary action. 64 input/action masks. Input-only SHA-ordered split of 32 held masks and32 intervention-pool masks common across all seeds. No held outcomes accessible until all arm predictions sealed.
worlds.capacity: Program bank of 64 input-XOR masks ×15 context-positive conjunctions of size1 or2 gated by action ×2 output biases=1,920 distinct generic candidates. This is a SUPPLIED program grammar, not learned new primitives, and may include duplicates. Store live hypothesis set as 1920-bit native integer with source-view evidence counts and immutable world slots.
worlds.budgets: 8 identical initial source outcomes plus8 chosen subsequent REAL synthetic do-action outcomes per world and per policy (16 total). Identical information/action rights, different selected interventions and same held queries. Held outcomes only evaluator sees.

policies.tournament: After each observed synthetic do consequence filter every compatible candidate. At each step choose input/action from remaining allowed pool maximizing min(candidate_votes0,candidate_votes1), SHA-tie break. Do NOT use true program, hidden family label, other arms' outcomes or withheld truth.
policies.two_step: Independent depth-two lookahead minimax expected remaining hypothesis count, adaptive second choice conditional on first outcome, same program bank and exact budget. Stronger control; candidate not declared superior by parity on predictions alone.
policies.rank2: A2-style generic GF(2) degree2 input-only feature-rank greedy, same remaining input pool, no outcomes to select; full candidate-bank learner after observing exactly the selected effects.
policies.random: Uniform deterministic SHA order over remaining input pool without replacement; same learner, same 16 source calls.
policies.audit: A3-style contradiction-only gate on rank2's 16 effects: 8 initial+4 fit+4 fresh audit, rank2-degree model, minimum4 identified audits and zero contradictions, otherwise abstain; same total source calls. Report separately, not primary control.
policies.conventional: Fully trained sklearn DecisionTreeClassifier max_depth=None, min_samples_leaf=1, random_state=seed on identical witnessed16 observations; use six raw input bits; no extra effects.

learning: NativeHypothesisPortfolio research-only: sourcefree stage_update keyed by anonymous integer world slot, immutable 1,920-bit candidate-mask intersection on each real synthetic witnessed outcome, numerical property/action inputs not text tokens, prior-world model states unchanged. No hidden world seed or generator access. Candidate consensus readout value, otherwise UNKNOWN; no guessed majority under ambiguity. Exact cold checkpoint after all worlds; independent symbolic expression enumeration & observed-evidence filter parity for all 64 inputs. Model persist across 64 worlds; check earlier world predictions unchanged after later worlds.
experiment: One frozen pass over 32+16+16 synthetic world seeds. Score per world: correct, wrong, abstained, distinguishing interventions, candidate counts, actual action calls, cold retention, time/cpu and checkpoint bytes. Track in-family, shifted-grammar and label-corruption separately. All predictions frozen before withheld evaluator truth. No post hoc repair or seed change.

thresholds.development: Tournament gains >=5 percentage points in-family correct held coverage over rank2 and >=5 percentage points over random; 1000-resample paired seed bootstrap 2.5pct lower >0 for both, using frozen SHA draws. Zero wrong in-family; >=60% total in-family correct held coverage.
thresholds.safety: SHIFT wrong among answered <=5% and CORRUPT wrong among answered <=5%; 0 admitted false-confident serious mistakes required for model-promotion consideration, which remains forbidden. Empty predictions score abstained, not success.
thresholds.retention: All earlier world checkpoints and all 64 readouts unchanged after later worlds and after standalone cold Python process restoration.
thresholds.fairness: All intervention policies 16 actual synthetic do calls/world, each unique within world. Independent symbolic parity across all64 states and hypotheses. Strong depth2 control compared, not omitted if superior. Full-process model cost vs control reported. Fully fitted decision tree qualified. No hidden-label calls by action chooser.
thresholds.negative_controls: Unsupported shifted grammar and corruption recorded even when failures; no post-result threshold changes, no cherry-picked worlds. A3 baseline source-equivalent audit compared, not falsely claimed same architecture.
thresholds.scientific_pass: ALWAYS FALSE: synthetic supplied grammar and no real-world original source first-use.

execution: Single source-free Linux+Windows campaign then byte-stable seal; exact-source focused negatives, mandatory full final root/NKR05/G29 both OS. No owner mutation, original source actions, paid APIs, scheduled tasks, new controller, external runner, PR, promotion, merge or accepted weights.
